snippet.title: Laser Thief - A Mixed Reality Laser Game [Official Trailer]
snippet.description:
Link to Game:
https://www.meta.com/de-de/experiences/laser-thief-a-mixed-reality-laser-game/8601091189913934/

🕶️ One thief. One mission. Your calling. 🕶️
Step into the heart-pounding world of Laser Thief on Meta Quest 3 & Meta Quest 3S, the ultimate mixed reality heist game that transforms your room into a thrilling battleground! You’re the daring thief, dodging lasers, ducking, and weaving through seven unique worlds on Meta Quest 3 & Meta Quest 3S, stealing everything from Viking relics to luxury cars. But can you handle Bomb Mode, where there’s only 120 seconds before BOOM?

In Laser Thief, YOUR ROOM—thanks to the power of Meta Quest 3 & Meta Quest 3S—becomes the playground for a legendary heist. Master crazy moves, dodge deadly poison bubbles, and make every second count. With endless levels, a hilarious narrator, and challenges that intensify with each heist, Laser Thief on Meta Quest 3 keeps thrill-seekers on the edge of their seats, delivering an immersive experience like no other!

🚨 Features:

    7 crazy worlds with increasing difficulty
    150+ amazing levels for endless fun
    Heart-racing Bomb Mode with a 120-second time limit
    Shrinking shield for those close calls
    Designed for endless replayability and fun

Are you ready to become the legend? If you survive… 😎

Download Laser Thief today on Meta Quest 3 & Meta Quest 3S and dive into the heist of a lifetime!

Note: Creators are welcome to use scenes from this trailer, but please remember to mention Laser Thief when sharing!👍
